items.verbatim: WEDC Grant under the Community Development Investment program, awarded 2021-03-26 to a recipient in City of Green Lake, Green Lake County. Industry: Accommodation (NAICS 721110). Award amount: $250,000. Planned project cost: $5,356,341. Planned capital investment: $13,166,464.
